title: Step 1: Visioning Session
body: Purpose, audience, agenda, facilitation and outputs of the Visioning Session that builds the broad use case list and secures executive alignment
kicker: 6 lessons · knowledge check at the end of this page
list_label: By the end of this module you can:
list: Plan a Visioning agenda with timed segments.
Capture a broad use case list and agree 3-5 priorities.
Deliver the recap and next steps within 24 hours.
footnote: Recommended before this module: SBP-104. Prerequisites are proposed; roadmap mappings are alignment only, not equivalency.
